name: canada-ai-components
description: Canada.ca Design System registry for AI coding agents. Self-contained, accessible Government of Canada components with bilingual (EN/FR) metadata and full adaptation/coordination support.

designSystem.name: Canada.ca (WET-BOEW + GC Design System)
designSystem.notes: Ground truth: WET-BOEW v19.6.0 (2026-08-18), the toolkit canada.ca serves. WET-BOEW ships no npm package, so the served stylesheet is vendored verbatim at infinite/ground-truth/wet-boew-19.6.0.css (its own header declares the version) and declared to staticView.classCheck. groundTruth is live-site, not installed-package: this is a snapshot mechanism, not a CI-installable one. canada.ca also loads GC Design System web components (@cdssnc/gcds-components) from an alpha CDN; GCDS styles live in shadow DOM and are not a verification target for these tiles.

metadataCategories.discovery: Facets for filtering in code (not sent to model)
metadataCategories.selection: useWhen/avoidWhen — helps choose the right component

gaps.reason: Not among the tiled Canada.ca components

gaps.nearestAlternative: alert-danger + inline role=alert error text per field
gaps.reason: Canada.ca handles validation errors inline per field; there is no page-level error summary component
gaps.consequence: Do not add a page-level error summary; validation errors surface inline per field (alert-danger + role=alert error text)
gaps.source: Canada.ca design system (https://design.canada.ca) — form guidance handles errors inline per field; no page-level error-summary component is published

gaps.reason: GC Design System documents the theme-and-topic menu (navigation to top tasks); the live canada.ca implementation is a gcweb-menu button loading a hierarchical AJAX panel via wet-boew — JS-heavy mirror queued

staticView.note: Resolved views render tiles self-contained; the ground-truth stylesheet is used only by the class check.

allowlist.reason: Site layer: used 14x on the canada.ca home page (2026-09-29) but NOT defined in WET-BOEW 19.6.0 or any stylesheet that page loads — a dead legacy class. Kept because the live markup uses it; WET-BOEW defines wb-eqht-grd.
Site layer: a canada.ca-specific class (1 use on the home page), not part of WET-BOEW. Declared in core-classes.json as a site component.
